opening.argument: The presentation is an Oracle licensing and support-cost webinar focused on renewal structures and ways customers may reduce support spending. It asks for copies of support renewals so the provider can assess what may be achieved, and directs interested viewers to Holly for follow-up. The accompanying slide offers help with upcoming renewals and describes a quote on a fixed-fee or gain-share basis. Those requests are presented as steps in a conventional consulting service, not as an unexplained demand for payment or credentials, or an investment opportunity. The discussion of potential savings does not establish that any particular customer saved money.

citations.quote: why many Oracle customers pay too much for support maintenance and what you can do to prevent spending more than necessary
We just need to have a copy of your support renewals and then, based upon that, we can tell you what can be achieved.
